code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (4,)}:
        pts = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        # Continue an existing diagonal run from its endpoint.
        for a in pts:
            for b in pts:
                dr, dc = b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]
                if dr and abs(dr)==abs(dc):
                    # Only unit diagonal neighbors define the continuation direction.
                    if abs(dr)==1:
                        nr, nc = b[0]+dr, b[1]+dc
                        if not (0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w) or grid[nr][nc] != color:
                            while 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and out[nr][nc] == 4:
                                out[nr][nc] = color
                                nr += dr; nc += dc
    return out
'''
